deep.reconstruction:
This page is a table of contents for a planned memoir. It is almost certainly the plan of the material Grothendieck presented in his Séminaire Bourbaki talk 'Réarrangements de fonctions et inégalités de convexité dans les algèbres de von Neumann munies d'une trace' (Exp. 113, 1955). The sections are:
(1) Notions on rearrangements of functions: the decreasing rearrangement f* of a measurable function on a measure space, in the Hardy–Littlewood–Pólya tradition.
(2) 'Weyl functions': the class of functions φ, probably convex functions of log t, for which Weyl-type inequalities Σ φ(|λ_i(T)|) ≤ Σ φ(s_i(T)) hold (H. Weyl 1949, relating eigenvalues and singular values).
(3) Fundamental inequalities for A in \bar a, where \bar a is the algebra of (measurable / closed affiliated) operators attached to a von Neumann algebra a equipped with a faithful normal semifinite trace.
(4) Spectral measures and the decreasing rearrangement of an operator. For a positive or normal operator A affiliated to (a, τ), the distribution function t ↦ τ(E_{(t,∞)}(|A|)) yields a decreasing function on (0, τ(1)). This is the generalized singular-value function μ_t(A), later systematised by Fack–Kosaki (1986). Here A ranges over the larger class \tilde{\bar a}.
(5) First properties of decreasing rearrangements, then 'Compléments sur le déterminant': the Fuglede–Kadison determinant (1952) expressed through the rearrangement, Δ(A) = exp ∫ log μ_t(A) dt.
(6) The fundamental inequality for AB. This is presumably the noncommutative Horn / Weyl log-majorization ∫_0^s log μ_t(AB) dt ≤ ∫_0^s log μ_t(A) dt + ∫_0^s log μ_t(B) dt (struck-out wording: 'inégalité de convexité dans les anneaux d'opérateurs').
(7) Other inequalities, presumably the Hölder- and Minkowski-type consequences and the trace inequalities τ(φ(|AB|)) ≤ ∫ φ(μ_t(A) μ_t(B)) dt.
The purpose is to extend the classical matrix majorization theory (Weyl, Horn, Ky Fan) and Hardy–Littlewood rearrangements to semifinite von Neumann algebras with a trace.
errors: No mathematical content to check; it is a plan only. The labels were renumbered (an inserted section was struck and the old No 5 became 'Compléments sur le déterminant'), so the final numbering is somewhat inconsistent.

deep.surprise_reason: This is a table of contents for work Grothendieck published as a Bourbaki exposé in 1955. It documents the planned structure, including a determinant section, but contains no new mathematics. Its historical value is as evidence of Grothendieck's priority (relative to Fack–Kosaki) on generalized singular values, and that priority is already in the literature.
transcription_corrections: Line 3: the inserted word above the struck 'de convexité ... liées aux réarrangements' is 'fondamentales', consistent with the transcription; the marginal annotation '(A ∈ \bar a)' sits under the line.
Line 4: the inserted word is 'décroissant' replacing struck 'spectral'; the annotation reads '(A ∈ \tilde{\bar a})' with a tilde over a bar.
The struck label before 'Premières propriétés' appears to be a scribbled label, not clearly 'No 5'. The final 'No 5' (overwritten from another digit) labels 'Compléments sur le déterminant'.
Line 6: 'L'inégalité fondamentale pour AB', with 'de convexité dans les anneaux d'opérateurs' struck out.
